_notes: servers: one entry per node. Required: name, kind.
url: the inference server's base URL (required for llama-router and vllm, omit for gpu-only).
sidecar: the gpu-sidecar URL on that host (optional; defaults to the server's host, port 9421).
description: free text shown in the UI (optional).
models: per-model hints — ctx (int), desc (UI text), vision (object) — optional.
models.<id>.vision: vision-route policy for this model: tier (int, lower =
preferred; default 10 — encode measured vision speed, e.g. 0 for the fastest),
image_capable (bool override for the /v1/models metadata — needed on older
llama.cpp builds that report text-only for a loaded mmproj), enabled (bool,
default true — set false to exclude from vision routing, e.g. text-only models).
top-level vision: policy for GET /api/vision/route (read-only advisor):
enabled (bool, default true), stale_after_s (default 60 — reject candidates
whose state is older), gpu_busy_threshold (percent, default 80 — ordering
penalty when the server's card is contended by co-tenants).
top-level gpu_sidecars: [{server, url}] — optional, overrides the per-server sidecar keys.

example-model.gguf.desc: optional per-model notes shown in the UI

example-model-27b.gguf.desc: loaded on demand — emergency-tier vision route

servers.name: example-gpu
servers.description: no inference API — GPU telemetry only
